subject.title: [Bug]: IRC channel reports healthy while dead-looping reconnects on a non-recoverable login error

question: For IRC reconnects after a successful session, should fatal login numerics permanently stop the account, or should the monitor keep retrying with capped backoff while reporting connected:false/lastError?
rationale: Both choices can be technically correct, but they create different operator recovery behavior after bans, K-lines, or rotated server passwords; automation should not pick fail-closed versus repairable retry policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Capped Backoff With Honest Status
options.body: Keep retrying in case the operator fixes the server-side condition, but publish connected:false/lastError and use capped backoff instead of a 1-second loop.

options.title: Terminal Fatal Failure
options.body: Treat 432/464/465 after reconnect as terminal, stop the monitor task, and surface a terminal failure until the operator restarts or reconfigures the account.

options.title: Status-Only First Slice
options.body: First publish connected:false/lastError on disconnects while leaving retry policy for a narrower follow-up decision.

recommendation.title: Capped Backoff With Honest Status
recommendation.body: Keep retrying in case the operator fixes the server-side condition, but publish connected:false/lastError and use capped backoff instead of a 1-second loop.

likelyOwner.reason: The current gateway health and IRC monitor lines are blamed to the #99707 current-main merge, so this is the best available routing owner for the policy choice.
